description:
Extended globs built at run time and nested deeply, and `globstar` over a deep tree. A pattern
nested past the limit fails wherever it is matched, rather than matching wrongly.

Each case name starts with `pattern depth: `.

cases.name: pattern depth: extended globs nested 24 deep
cases.script:
shopt -s extglob; cd /tmp; touch a
for kind in @ + '?' '*'; do p=$(printf "$kind(%.0s" {1..24})a$(printf ')%.0s' {1..24}); [[ a == $p ]]; echo "$kind [[ $?"; case a in $p) echo "$kind case";; esac; x=aa; echo "$kind ${x#$p} ${x%%$p} ${x/$p/b}"; echo "$kind" $p; done
p=$(printf '@(%.0s' {1..12})a$(printf '|b)%.0s' {1..12}); [[ b == $p ]]; echo "alt $?"

cases.name: pattern depth: nested negations
cases.script: shopt -s extglob; for n in 1 2 3 8 13; do p=$(printf '!(%.0s' $(seq $n))a$(printf ')%.0s' $(seq $n)); for s in a b ab ''; do [[ $s == $p ]]; printf %s $?; done; echo " $n"; done

cases.name: pattern depth: extended globs nested deeper are refused
cases.script:
shopt -s extglob; cd /tmp; touch a
p=$(printf '@(%.0s' {1..25})a$(printf ')%.0s' {1..25})
[[ a == $p ]]; echo "[[ $?"
case a in $p) echo case;; esac
x=aa; echo "${x#$p}"
echo $p
p=$(printf '@(%.0s' {1..1500})a$(printf ')%.0s' {1..1500})
[[ a == $p ]]; echo "[[ $?"
p=$(printf '!(%.0s' {1..20})abcdefgh$(printf ')%.0s' {1..20})
[[ b == $p ]]; echo "[[ $?"
echo after

stderr.text:
bash: line 3: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool
bash: line 4: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool
bash: line 5: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool
bash: line 6: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool
bash: line 8: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool
bash: line 10: maximum nesting level exceeded: deeper nesting is unsupported in bash-tool

expected.reason: bash-tool's limit: an extended glob is translated to a regular expression recursively, one or two groups per level, so one nested more than 24 deep, or a negation whose translation grows past 512 KiB, fails where it is matched and ends that command line (README, Limits); bash matches it

cases.name: pattern depth: globstar walks a deep tree
cases.script:
cd /tmp && d=$(printf 'd/%.0s' {1..40}) && mkdir -p "$d" d/e d/.h && touch d/f "${d}g" d/e/x d/.h/y
shopt -s globstar
n=0; for f in d/**; do n=$((n+1)); done; echo "all $n"
n=0; for f in d/**/; do n=$((n+1)); done; echo "dirs $n"
set -- d/**/g; echo "g $# ${#1}"
echo d/**/x d/**/y d/**/f
mkdir -p t/a/b t/c && touch t/a/f t/c/g t/.z t/a/b/h; echo t/**; echo t/**/; echo t/**/h
shopt -s dotglob; echo d/**/y; echo t/**
